title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta3

## Selectable LiDAR terrain overlay

This beta adds the Map Card side of the persistent LiDAR terrain resources introduced by Navimower 0.4.5-beta4.

### LiDAR overlay

- Add a separate **LiDAR overlay** selector with `None`, `LiDAR terrain` and `LiDAR elevation` modes plus adjustable opacity.
- Read only the integration-provided `frontend.terrain_overlay` capability and authenticated Home Assistant image endpoints; private cloud download URLs remain backend-only.
- Align the WebP resource directly in the integration-provided `mower_local_xy` extent, without georeferencing it through OSM or another base-map provider.
- Keep LiDAR above the selected base underlay but below Navimow zones, boundaries, current-cycle mowing, trails, Gate areas, labels and mower graphics.
- Cache authenticated WebP responses as browser object URLs by mower/resource/version and revoke superseded or disconnected resources.

### Multi mower

- Render LiDAR per mower using each member's terrain capability and existing `svg_matrix` site transform.
- Keep the LiDAR layer between the shared site underlay and the normal Multi-mower map graphics.
- Mowers without an advertised terrain resource are simply skipped, so mixed LiDAR/non-LiDAR sites remain valid.

### Compatibility

- LiDAR rendering requires **Navimower 0.4.5-beta4 or newer**; **0.4.5-beta6 is recommended** because it is also the matching backend for the retained-trail and authenticated OSM behavior already used by Map Card 0.3.7-beta2.
- Existing cards remain unchanged by default because `terrain_overlay` defaults to `none`.
- OSM, Estonia orthophoto/hybrid, Google Satellite, History, current-cycle trails, Gate areas, scheduler and non-LiDAR mower behavior are otherwise unchanged.
